### Internal libraries

| Package | Role |
|---|---|
| `r2luna/brain` ^4.1 | Validated Actions and queued workflows under `app/Brain` |
| `laravel/ai` ^0.10.1 | Laravel AI SDK and agent conversation support |

### Shared infrastructure

- Horizon supervises Redis queues `high_priority`, `low_priority`, and `long_timeout`; configured maximum worker counts are 4, 4, and 3 (`config/horizon.php`).
- Laravel queue storage provides jobs, batches, failed jobs, and configurable queue-name prefixes (`config/queue.php`, database migrations).
- Laravel cache supports alert throttling and queue diagnostics; Redis or database drivers are configured in `config/cache.php`.
- Laravel logging plus Opcode Log Viewer provide operational logging and inspection (`config/logging.php`, `config/log-viewer.php`).
- OwenIt Auditing records auditable model changes; `User` implements its `Auditable` contract (`app/Models/User.php`).
- Browsershot/Puppeteer and Playwright supply HTML rendering and browser-test infrastructure (`composer.json`, `package.json`).
